_note.status: Prototype data from real sources, simplified. Not for any decision about real tips, quarries or flood risk.
_note.frame: Same km frame as the national map: x=(lon+5.40)*111.32*cos(52.4 deg), y=(53.50-lat)*111.2. y grows southward. Polygon rings are implicitly closed (last point not repeated). Coordinates rounded to 0.001 km.

_note.busRoutes: Only the bus route relations mapped in OSM. Coverage is incomplete. Each direction or variant is its own entry. busStops are whatever OSM has. rail[].status keeps OSM railway=razed as 'dismantled'; disused:railway and abandoned:railway ways are kept with status disused/abandoned and a 'was' field.
_note.coalTips: The official Welsh Government / Mining Remediation Authority 'Disused Coal Tips in Wales' dataset (DataMapWales map 7548) is marked PERSONAL USE ONLY, not an open dataset, viewing only. It was NOT downloaded or used. tips[] holds only OSM spoil heaps and BGS tip-related landslide records, each labelled by source.
